ready.description: Every ready task upstream of the task, in frontier order: the task alone when it is ready itself; empty when it is done, or when every path from it ends at something stuck.

stuck.description: Every blocking ID met upstream that no work on ready tasks clears — missing, unusable, or duplicated, or a task in a cycle — in ascending order.

tasks.description: Present only when include_tasks is true: the task first, then every other open task upstream of it. Task views, or Task projections with fields.
